topic: Turning on the heating for the first time this winter
passage: Last Sunday night, the living room felt colder than usual. I looked at the thermometer and saw that it had dropped to ten degrees. I decided to turn on the heating for the first time this winter. First, I looked up the instructions in an old notebook and wiped the dust off the heater. Then I plugged it in and turned the switch on. Nothing happened at first, so I checked the plug and tried again. After a few seconds, the heater started. I sat down on the sofa and waited, but the air still felt cold. My wife walked over and pointed out that the window was still open. I jumped up, closed it, and pulled the curtains together. Then I turned the heat up a little and put on a thick sweater. Twenty minutes later, the room warmed up, and we took out a blanket and watched a short film. I wrote down a reminder to clean the filter next week. Before bed, I turned the heat down and promised not to leave it on all night. The first warm evening of winter cheered us up.

shadow_sentences.text: I decided to turn on the heating last Sunday.
My wife pointed out that the window was open.
I turned the heat down before bed.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录，主弱项继续是过去式 -ed 听辨和短语动词连读，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「今冬第一次开暖气」是全新的日常话题，短文里有 looked/dropped/decided/wiped/plugged/turned/checked/tried/started/waited/walked/pointed/jumped/closed/pulled/warmed/watched/promised/cheered 等规则过去式；looked at、turn on、looked up、wiped off、plugged it in、sat down、walked over、pointed out、jumped up、turned the heat up、put on、warmed up、took out、wrote down、turned the heat down、cheered us up 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
